transcript.text: Good morning everyone. As we all know, we have 480 precision castings from Cell 7 on quality hold after yesterday's abnormal cooling event. The initial visual inspection came back clean with no visible cracks, but the castings haven't been released to machining yet. Before I make a final disposition, I'd like to go through our standard pre-disposition review. I need to check in with metrology, maintenance, and production control. Could we start by hearing from maintenance on the status of the cooling system repair and what caused the abnormal event? And from metrology, do we have any dimensional or non-destructive testing results beyond the visual inspection? Production control, I'd also like to understand the current scheduling impact and the timeline for the planned production pause. Let's work through this systematically so we can get the right disposition on these castings.
